alex: TL;DR: sampleapp background flow hitting duplicate POSTs + occasional stall on Android 12/13 when using our default OkHttp + RetryInterceptor. Repro steps in thread. Anyone seen this retry+auth ordering quirk? :wave:
mina: open question: are you using a blocking refresh inside the auth interceptor? that often causes races with retry logic.
alex: yes, AuthInterceptor does a blocking refresh on 401 and uses the same client instance. flow: request -> 401 -> AuthInterceptor does client.newCall(refreshReq).execute() -> update token -> retry original. when network flaky the RetryInterceptor sometimes replays the original POST while refresh is still in-flight, leading to dup posts.
own: that sounds bad. simplest fix: use a dedicated no-retry client for token refresh and mark non-idempotent endpoints as non-retriable.
alex: patched locally and it fixed duplicates. also saw a separate cancel issue: when the UI cancels a streaming suspend call, the underlying OkHttp socket sometimes stays in CLOSE_WAIT on Pixel devices behind corporate VPN, and the next request stalls for ~15s. emulator unaffected.
mina: two different bugs but both surfacing in sampleapp onboarding = bad DX. For the retry+auth: recommend changing AuthInterceptor to call the refresh client with retries disabled and callTimeout tighter. For dup POSTs, also add a default RetryPolicy that treats token-exchange endpoints as non-retriable.
devx-bot: Issue created: #8012 "Duplicate POSTs caused by RetryInterceptor + blocking auth refresh on mobile"
infra-bot: Suggestion: add a lint check that warns if RetryInterceptor is added before AuthInterceptor in client builder.
own: for the cancel/stall: pragmatic SDK mitigation is a Kotlin suspend wrapper that binds coroutine cancellation to Call.cancel(). e.g.:

```kotlin
suspend fun <T> Call.awaitSuspend(): T = suspendCancellableCoroutine { cont ->
  cont.invokeOnCancellation { cancel() }
  enqueue(object: Callback { ... onResponse -> cont.resume(result) })
}
```

that avoids sockets lingering when coroutine is cancelled. sampleapp can opt-in.
mina: nice. also document Pixel+VPN caveat in onboarding and include a sample flag in SDK builder: autoCancelOnCoroutineCancel = true. make opt-in initially.
alex: i'll open a small PR with three things: 1) AuthInterceptor uses noRetryClient for refresh, 2) add lint warning for interceptor ordering, 3) add suspend helper + builder flag and sampleapp example. will include instrumented test that cancels and immediately issues a follow-up request on Pixel 7/8 emulators.
own: please also add a small integration test for duplicate POST repro (simulate connect timeout + auth refresh).
devx-bot: CI presubmit started for draft PR/1620
mina: great. once CI green, let's ship as opt-in and monitor canary traffic. if stable, consider flip default in next minor. tagging security for the refresh-client change. :lock:
